en.description: Selected models route through the proxy with automatic retries.
en.fieldProxiedModelsHint: Proxy routing is per API base URL: selecting one model also routes all models sharing that host.
en.fieldProxyHostHint: Proxy server hostname or IP; does not have to be this machine.
en.fieldRetriesHint: Max retry attempts on failure (network error / 429 / 5xx), 0–10.
en.invalidEmpty: Proxy host must not be empty.
en.invalidRange: Port or numeric value out of range.
en.statusUnavailable: Settings service unavailable; the proxy configuration cannot be read or written.
en.testBarHint: Test uses the saved routing; save before testing a newly proxied model.
en.title: Proxy Model (dsh-llm-proxy)
